questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and cross traffic go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a nearby fire station. Be prepared for emergency vehicles on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn you about hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you of an upcoming sharp turn. Reduce your speed when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the right lane is ending. You must move into the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means the action shown is not allowed. You cannot make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive with extra caution in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights always follow the same color order. On vertical lights, red is on top and green is on the bottom. On horizontal lights, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs mark construction zones where dangers exist for both drivers and workers. This sign tells you that penalties for unsafe driving are doubled in this work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane. Be prepared to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If your wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has multiple turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are used only to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign means a flagger is ahead. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. This puts you at risk of a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming hazards. This sign alerts you that farm machinery may be on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you lanes are shifting. Stay alert and follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The speed limit is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs show the maximum safe speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs require drivers to stop and yield the right-of-way at an intersection. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must follow all instructions on these signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.
